designation.label: tt-tnt-1024
designation.reason: The 512-context dialogue-slice weights (10,764 steps, one epoch over tokens-v4), now shipping a chat template baked into tokenizer_config.json that caps rendered conversation history at the last 5 messages. This pairing is the point: the guard -- not a larger context -- is what prevents the growing-conversation KV-cache crash that is a generic tt-metal/vLLM defect (reproduced identically on stock meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct; docs/upstream-tt-metal-asks.md entry 6). Measured directly at 512 context, the exact crash condition: 14 growing turns, zero crashes, prompt_tokens plateauing at ~102 while messages sent grew to 27, against a hard engine crash at turn 3 before the guard existed. These weights answer questions in form and sometimes in fact ('The color of the sky is blue' outright; 'The city of Turin is the capital of the Province of Turin' -- grammatical, on-topic, factually off), where every 2048-context checkpoint trained returned circular or looping non-answers.
designation.qualification: Not unqualified. These are the SAME weights this project designated on 2026-08-18, with a chat template added -- no training improved them, and their known regression stands: 4-gram repeat rate worse than tt-tnt-1024a at 3.32x the seed floor, visible in plain output ('the sky is blue because it is blue because it is blue'), and the spider-legs question still returns a repetition loop. What changed on 2026-08-29 is that a 2048-context replacement was trained, published, measured to be WORSE at question answering, and reverted -- so this designation is a restoration, not an advance. The reason 2048 degraded Q&A was NOT isolated: the epoch-inflation hypothesis (steps held at 10,764 while seq_len quadrupled, taking epochs 1.00 -> 4.00) was tested by a six-checkpoint epoch sweep and NOT supported -- termination came back non-monotone and every comparison against this checkpoint was NOT SIGNIFICANT at n=32, and the metrics chosen carried no signal at all. The discriminating evidence is Q&A coherence, which was READ rather than scored, and the 512-vs-2048 comparison is confounded by epochs and sequence length moving together. Anyone re-raising the context should treat the mechanism as open and should not assume fewer epochs fixes it. Separately: this is a 512-window model, so its loss is not comparable to tt-tnt-v3's 2048-window figure -- evaluate() windows at cfg.seq_len, and comparing across windows is the error this file exists to prevent.

trajectory_refusal: skipped by --skip-trajectory; no training-time loss comparison is reported

prediction_refuted_2026_08_31.prediction: Declared before the run: with 100% of base weights frozen, LoRA trained on 100% task data would NOT reproduce full-parameter SFT's repetition regression -- 4-gram repeat and longest repeated span would come back at or below 1.2x the seed floor, against 21.76x and 30.17x for the same mix with full parameters.
prediction_refuted_2026_08_31.outcome: REFUTED. 18.46x and 27.07x -- the same regression, marginally smaller.

matched_comparison.mix: identical: editor pairs + poetry + skits, 86,029 examples, no base-blend slice
matched_comparison.baseline_values_agree: 0.0366 / 3.7472 / 0.0465 in both reports, so the two are directly comparable rather than merely similar

prediction_refuted_2026_08_31.why_the_prediction_was_wrong: The reasoning was 'the base weights cannot move, so behaviour cannot regress'. That is a non-sequitur, and the freeze is not what failed -- it held exactly as designed, 66/66 base parameters bit-identical after training, verified at NATIVE precision. What is served is not the base model: LoraLinear computes W + (alpha/rank)*(B@A), so the EFFECTIVE weights differ from W wherever an adapter was injected. Freezing W constrains the RANK of the update, not its effect. A rank-8 update applied to q/kv/out_linear across all 8 blocks is entirely capable of teaching the model to repeat itself, and did.
prediction_refuted_2026_08_31.what_lora_did_buy: Slightly less of the same damage on repetition (18.46x vs 21.76x, 27.07x vs 30.17x) and termination (1.33x vs 2.14x), at the cost of register: it turned two signals the full-parameter arm left NOT INTERPRETABLE into real regressions (tinystories margin 1.59x, nearest-source 1.85x). Matched-window loss moved -0.0267, with no seed floor for that instrument, so it is reported and not interpreted. Read plainly: LoRA is not an anti-forgetting mechanism here, it is a differently-shaped fine-tune.
prediction_refuted_2026_08_31.what_still_stands: The base-blend counterweight remains the only intervention measured to fix this regression (editor run 3: termination NOT INTERPRETABLE at 0.10x, 4-gram repeat BETTER at 3.00x). It costs 60% of every step and it works; the freeze is free and does not.
limitations: One seed, one run per arm.

step_3000 selected as the final checkpoint, matching the full-parameter arm's step_3000. Validation was still falling monotonically at 3000, so this run was undertrained for its own objective -- an earlier or later checkpoint was not evaluated.
Rank 8 on q/kv/out_linear only. A smaller rank, or targeting fewer modules, constrains the update further and was not tried; the prediction may hold at some rank, and this run does not locate it.
